newsitem.title: USA: Marvel bondholders seize control of company.
newsitem.headline: Marvel bondholders seize control of company.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group's bondholders on Friday said they seized control of the boards of both Marvel and Toy Biz Inc and named investor Carl Icahn as chairman of Marvel.

The bondholders also said they placed Icahn on the board of directors at Toy Biz, whose shares are more than 70.0 percent owned by Marvel. They will also bring in a transition team headed by former Marvel executive Joseph Calamari to lead the company back to financial health, the bondholders said.
The moves follow a judge's decision earlier in the day to reject a request by Marvel's banks and management for an emergency order to block the bondholders.
Officials at Marvel were not immediately available to comment. Earlier in the day, Marvel said it would appeal the judge's decision.
"We voted the stock to oust the board," said a person close to the bondholders, who declined to be named. "We had 80.0 percent of the stock that was collateral on the bonds, and we voted it."
